data.title: Electricity Supply Contract Confirmation – MusterStrom Flex (Stadtwerke Musterstadt)
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH confirms Sam Rivera's new electricity supply contract "MusterStrom Flex" for Beispielweg 5, 12345 Musterstadt, starting 01.10.2025 with a 12-month initial term and a monthly advance payment (Abschlag) of 48.00 €.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that your new home now has an electricity contract with Stadtwerke Musterstadt, effective from the delivery start date. You should submit your meter reading by the date shown in the letter so your consumption is billed correctly from the start. A monthly advance payment of 48.00 € will be collected by direct debit; this is an estimate and will be reconciled against your actual usage later. Keep the enclosed terms (AGB) for reference. If prices change later, you would get a separate notice with a special right to cancel — no action is needed from you now besides sending the meter reading.

Monatlicher Abschlag   48,00 €, fällig jeweils zum 15. eines Monats, erstmals am 15.10.2025
